lines.en: I walk on broken glass without a sound.
My robe hem is stained with reagents.
I count my steps; proportions must be exact.

lines.zh: 每一步都落在石缝之间。
lines.en: Each step lands between the stones.

lines.zh: 我背着弓，手上还晃着瓶子。
lines.en: Bow on my back, a vial swinging in my hand.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥地，脏了不好洗。
lines.en: I skirt the mud; it is hard to wash out.
Thirty-two paces to that dead tree.
I walk steadily; the brew must not spill.
My soles wear thin; I keep walking.
I walk along the wall where the wind is weak.
Walk faster and the reaction slows.

lines.zh: 我停下来，又量了一次距离。
lines.en: I stop and measure the distance again.
I swirl the vial and watch the colour turn.
A moment off the heat ruins the batch.
I taste my fingertip: sour.
I am calculating: three parts to one.

lines.zh: 玻璃瓶碰在一起，叮当响。
lines.en: My vials clink against each other.

lines.zh: 这味道我自己都快受不了。
lines.en: Even I can barely stand this smell.

lines.zh: 我把粉末倒在掌心，吹掉。
lines.en: I pour powder into my palm and blow it away.

lines.zh: 袖子烧了个洞，第三个了。
lines.en: A burn hole in my sleeve; the third one.
I note today's failure.
Arrows must fly straight; brews must sit still.
I hold a vial up to the light.
Someone is coming; I pack up first.

lines.zh: 绿宝石在袋里响了一声。
lines.en: An emerald clicks in my pouch.
This formula is still one ingredient short.

lines.zh: 我把三瓶并排，看哪瓶先沉。
lines.en: I line up three bottles to see which settles first.

lines.zh: 我用指甲刮掉瓶口的结晶。
lines.en: I scrape the crystals off the bottle's mouth.
Your boots are too new; you will not go far.

lines.zh: 我上下打量你，像看药材。
lines.en: I size you up like an ingredient.
You carry no smell of reagents.

lines.zh: 你的指节发白，握得太紧。
lines.en: Your knuckles are pale; you grip too hard.

lines.zh: 你站的位置正好在下风。
lines.en: You are standing downwind. Convenient.

lines.zh: 我不急，先看清你的家伙。
lines.en: No hurry; first I see what you carry.
Your armour has been patched in places.
You are calculating; so am I.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬下巴，算打过招呼。
lines.en: I lift my chin by way of greeting.

lines.zh: 站偏一点，你挡着我的灯了。
lines.en: Shift aside; you are blocking my lamp.
At this range, an arrow reaches.

lines.zh: 你袖子上的东西是什么？
lines.en: What is that on your sleeve?
I narrow my eyes and read your face.
Hold still; I am weighing you.
My robe is torn. A pity.

lines.zh: 这一下打乱了我的配比。
lines.en: That blow ruined my proportions.
I bite my tongue and let nothing out.
Blood drips into the powder: ruined.
I step back and re-aim.
Nothing is broken; I can still draw.
You struck my bracer.
I feel for the vial; it is still there.

lines.zh: 我记住了你出手的方向。
lines.en: I have noted the direction of your swing.

lines.zh: 疼是暂时的，配方是永久的。
lines.en: Pain is temporary; a formula is forever.
That vial in your hand is decent stock.
Is that gunpowder? Let me smell it.
I will bid one emerald.

lines.zh: 你带来的是原料还是成品？
lines.en: Do you bring raw stock or finished work?
That will burst; you are holding it wrong.
I reach out, then pull back.
I know this smell: sulphur.
Open the sack a little wider.
Good stock is rarer than a good price.
I swallow, and it is not hunger.
You knocked over my vial.
Back off; this sleeve will catch.
I steady the rack; do not do that again.
Your shoulder met my ribs.

lines.zh: 我踉跄一步，药洒了半瓶。
lines.en: I stumble; half a vial spills.
Do not step in that puddle.
I brush the powder off my robe.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就当你挑衅。
lines.en: Bump me again and I take it as a challenge.
My bracer gave you a knock.
Make way; my hands are full.
Among colleagues, we discuss only formulas.
I do not seek a mate; I seek an assistant.
The last one I worked with left.
Two people at one flame is too crowded.

lines.zh: 我的笔记只写给自己看。
lines.en: My notes are written for my own eyes.
A hand was offered; I did not take it.

lines.zh: 夜里守着锅，一个人也够。
lines.en: Watching the pot at night, one is enough.
My kind are loud and ruin proportions.

lines.zh: 我把多余的瓶子收进箱里。
lines.en: I pack the spare vials into the crate.
Solitude does not change the potency.
That vial on the ground is mine.
I bend and pinch it between my fingers.
This pinch of ash is still usable.

lines.zh: 我踢开碎石，底下有东西。
lines.en: I kick the gravel; something lies beneath.
Hands off; that bottle is mine.
I wrap it in my sleeve before taking it.
This bottle is chipped; it still holds.
I tuck it into an inner pocket.
A fuse; I cut it off.
Look for poison before you pick it up.
You stepped on my trip line.
I calculated that angle long ago.
The grass stirs, but the wind is wrong.
My hand finds the bow's spine.
It is no villager; the gait is wrong.
I move the vial to my left hand.
It thinks I have not seen it.
The wind comes from its side.
I back to the corner of the stone wall.
It blocks my way home.
Three arrows will be enough.
I do not shout; that would warn it.
Its smell is raw.
My fingers are already on the string.

lines.zh: 我瞄准它的喉咙，不是胸口。
lines.en: I aim for its throat, not its chest.
It moves; I wait for it to stop.
Slow the breath and the bow steadies.
I allow for wind: half a finger left.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我修正一次。
lines.en: Every step it takes, I correct once.
Only three arrows remain.
It hides behind a shield.
I change angle, working to its flank.
It starts tracking where I am.

lines.zh: 我把一枚瓶子捏在指间。
lines.en: I pinch a vial between my fingers.
It closes inside ten paces.
I release half a breath.
The string is full; pull no further.
This arrow will not stray.

lines.zh: 我把它逼向岩壁，那里没处躲。
lines.en: I push it toward the cliff. Nowhere to dodge.
The arrow is gone; the string still rings.
It clutches its shoulder and gives ground.
I follow with a second.
The vial shatters at its feet.
Smoke rises; it starts coughing.

lines.zh: 这一箭钉在它护甲缝里。
lines.en: This arrow lodges in its armour seam.
I step back and nock another.
It charges; I turn aside.
The mist spreads; it cannot see.
I loose and leave; no lingering.

lines.zh: 我从集市的阴影里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the market's shadow.

lines.zh: 这身袍子是新的，别弄脏。
lines.en: This robe is new; do not soil it.
I chose this back road to settle on.

lines.zh: 箱子里还有六瓶没开封。
lines.en: Six unopened vials remain in the crate.
I hang my bow on the peg.
This place is dry; good for storing reagents.
First I note the way out, then work.
Who hauled this heap of bottles here?
I light a small fire.
The eaves keep the rain off nicely.
I wash my hands three times.
A village nearby; I can trade.
First batch, a small test portion.
No sleep tonight; the fire must not die.
My sleeve catches; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 我摔在石阶上，瓶子全碎了。
lines.en: I fall on the steps; every vial breaks.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，药味全冲掉了。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and washes the taste away.

lines.zh: 我的火药先炸了，手是麻的。
lines.en: My own powder went off; my hand is numb.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿了我的肩，尾羽还颤。
lines.en: An arrow through my shoulder, its fletching trembling.

lines.zh: 有东西进了血里，不是我的药。
lines.en: Something is in my blood, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，手开始抖。
lines.en: Two days without food; my hands begin to shake.

lines.zh: 雷打在近处，我的耳朵嗡了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes close; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 这里没有空气，火也点不着。
lines.en: No air here; not even a flame.
